utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. I’ll make a simple list of what’s still needed, and we can compare notes when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, Eli — I’ll check in when I’m back and we can compare notes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the main thing you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just help me sort the tools and keep track of who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can do that — I’ll sort the tools and keep a quick list of who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, is the repair drive still happening today?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d want to confirm the time and whether they still need volunteers before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the time and whether they still need volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring over my old tools, but I left them by the back door again. If you still need help, I can run home and grab them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Oren—those tools would really help. I’m keeping the list here, so bring whatever you can find.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll run back now and grab what I can find. Be right over with the tools!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say yes, can you remind me what’s being repaired and what you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, right — it’s the repair drive for the broken stuff around the block, and I’m asking if you can help out with a little time or maybe a contribution. Sorry, I should’ve led with that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for clarifying — what kind of contribution are you looking for, and when would you need my help?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m here—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane—thanks for coming. We still need help sorting tools and loading the donated supplies, then we can head over together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can sort the tools and help load the supplies. Point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you bring your drill and a few screws, and help me sort the donated parts when you get here?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my drill and some screws, and I’ll help sort the donated parts when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive locations, so I can help if you need the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — that’d help a lot. Could you send me the repair drive locations when you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll send you the repair drive locations as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can help keep track—where’s the repair drive being held?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s at the community center on Maple Street—come by Saturday morning and bring anyone who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, I’ll spread the word and swing by Saturday morning. Thanks for the heads-up!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Rey? Do you need any help or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s going pretty well so far — we could use a few more screws and some extra paint if you have any.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive, and I’ll keep repeating the details so folks don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’d appreciate that. I’m still hearing about it second-hand, so the repeated details really help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — it’s the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday, and I’ll keep telling people the time and place so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized and wanted to check what still needs attention on your end.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa — thanks for checking in. I’m still sorting a few things out on my end, but I’ll let you know as soon as I know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I appreciate it. Just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll keep the drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re still taking donations and volunteers this week—sounds like they’re trying to wrap up the big fixes before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible. I’ll stop by and see where they need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nice, Eli—that’ll probably help a lot. If you spot the signup sheet, let me know what they’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’m trying to line up a few hands for the repair drive, mostly sorting tools and checking in with folks. If you’re free, could you help me with that?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I can help with that — I’ll sort the tools and check in with folks.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I still need to sort the list of needed repairs and see what parts we already have.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort the list and check the parts we already have. Want to go through it together?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I need the exact drop-off spot for the repair drive—could you tell me where it’s being held?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would be really helpful, Jules. Could you share the date, time, and where people should go so I can pass it along accurately?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — just send me the date, time, and meeting spot, and I’ll help pass it along clearly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Totally—if you can, bring any spare tools, extension cords, or basic fix-it supplies you’ve got, and I’ll make sure they get put to use.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I can bring a toolbox, an extension cord, and some tape if I find it. What time should I drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help, Leo—what do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m looking for a few basic tools and any spare screws or tape you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring some spare screws and tape, and I’ll check for a few basic tools too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to sort the logistics first—who’s handling pickup and where should we drop everything off?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can handle pickup if you tell me the time, and we can drop everything at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me — I just need a pickup time so I can plan around it. The community center drop-off sounds easiest.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling a few neighbors about the repair drive now—want me to add you to the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please add me. I can bring some supplies for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put you on the list and let everyone know you’re bringing supplies. Thanks, Cleo!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around the school schedule, but I’ll need the repair drive times first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I haven’t written the repair drive times down yet. I’ll check and get them to you as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — just send them over when you have them, and I’ll fit it around the school day.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m putting together the repair drive list now, so we can keep track of what each neighbor needs. If you’ve heard of any urgent fixes, send them my way and I’ll add them in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard anything urgent yet, but I’ll ask around and pass along whatever I learn.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate you checking around. I’ll keep the list updated, so just send anything urgent my way when you hear it.
